thread:
Anya: quick heads-up from the quant bakeoff run I kicked off overnight — AWQ int8 hybrid is producing duplicated placeholder tokens when we batch multiple examples. Repro on internal dev set 7/8 seeds. Example (minimal):

Anya: prompt: "Write a short summary of the following note:
- user: bought 2 items
- qty: 2"

Expected:
```
Summary: User bought 2 items (qty 2).
```

Observed (AWQ int8, batch_size=8):
```
Summary: User bought 2 items <|placeholder|><|placeholder|> (qty 2).
```

This only shows up when batch_size > 1, and seems correlated with enabling KV cache and the awq q4_0 profile. FP8 candidate and GPTQ candidate do not show this duplication in the same config.

Mike: i've seen a minor dup artifact with fp8 on longpad, but never this clear multi-dup token. Is the placeholder a sentinel token from the prompt or an unknown mapping? :thinking:

Sara: can you paste the exact model + quant flags & the command you used?

Anya: model: redwood/tiny-chat-3b-v1 (onboard candidate)
quant: awq-int8-q4_0 (fused-attn kernels), batch_size=8, kv_cache=true, pad_to_multiple_of=8
run command: `./tools/run_bakeoff.sh --model redwood/tiny-chat-3b-v1 --quant awq-int8-q4_0 --batch 8 --kv-cache --evalset dev-v2`

quant-bot: automated results: BLEU drop -6.3 vs float32, placeholder-dup rate 12% on multi-item batches, hallucination rate +3.2% (sampled). Full report: s3://redwood-evals/1930123456/summary.json

Leo: sounds like a tokenizer/id mismatch or a fused-embedding kernel bug where sentinel token id ends up duplicated across batch slots. Two quick checks: force `pad_to_multiple_of=1` + `batch_size=1` to confirm it disappears, and try `--tokenizer fast=false` to disable fast-BPE. Also check whether the sentinel token id >= vocab_size when using the fused embedding lookup.

Jamal: i'll run a per-layer bisect for AWQ to see which quantized op introduces this. plan: toggle quantization for embedding, attn q/k/v, proj out per-layer and run 500 samples. script: `scripts/quant_bisect.sh --model redwood/tiny-chat-3b-v1 --profile awq-int8-q4_0 --scope layers --samples 500`

Anya: quick bisect result: enabling AWQ quant on embedding + first attn proj (q,k) reproduces the dup. If I leave embedding float but quantize later layers, dup disappears. GPTQ candidate with same per-layer layout doesn't show dup. So this smells like an AWQ-specific packing/kernel issue in the embedding->attn handoff.

Mike: thanks. we should canary a fix that disables AWQ for embedding on the dedicated pool until we patch. Rollout policy: canary on 5% traffic, monitor placeholder-dup >5% to rollback automatically. Add an auto-fallback to fp8 for the route.

Sara: opened ticket INF-743, added reproducer, bakeoff logs, and the bisect matrix. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-743 (internal).

quant-bot: added eval traces to the ticket and flagged the model for blocked promotion in the catalog until resolved.

Leo: short-term patch: patch AWQ fused-embed to clamp sentinel ids and add a unit test that runs multi-item batches with pad variants. Jamal, can you add the unit test to `eng-ml/tests/quant`?

Jamal: on it. i'll also test with `--no-fused-embed` to confirm perf vs correctness tradeoff. initial estimate: 1-2 dev days to produce fix + tests.

Anya: plan for next steps: 1) Jamal bisect + unit test 2) Leo PR for clamp & CI test 3) Canary disable AWQ embedding on dedicated pools 4) re-run bakeoff. I'll update INF-743 with a postmortem once we have a root cause.

Mike: 👍 thanks team, cc @ops for canary config.

Sara: noted, closing loop after canary results. :eyes:
